notes:
POC objective: validate Dedicated capacity sizing, guaranteed throughput, and latency SLOs for customer-facing chat and document search. Short bullets / CRM style:
- Primary contact: CTO Andrea Lopez (security-first).
- Workloads: mixed chat (conversational assistant) + embeddings for semantic search + reranking on search results. Expected peak: ~180 qps for chat-like requests, average tokens ~150, embeddings parallel batch jobs off-peak.
- Latency SLO targets: p50 < 40ms for short prompts (~64 tokens), p95 < 120ms for conversational prompts (~150 tokens), p99 < 300ms. Business requirement: 95% of user interactions feel <200ms.
- Throughput/soak targets: sustain 120 qps steady-state for 72 hours (soak), ramp to 180 qps for 30-minute stress windows. Verify no memory growth, KV-cache eviction behavior.
- Representative prompt sets: customer support intents (avg len 60-200 tokens), KYC doc summarization (large context 2k-6k tokens), reranking top-50 results (embed + cross-encoder). Drive file with canonical prompt set: drive:/performance/maplebridge-load-test-plan.md.
- Reserved GPU planning: initial recommendation from infra team: 4 x A100 80GB for baseline, scale to 6 x H100 for peak 180 qps with quantized model. Discuss quantization/TF32 tradeoffs with model ops. SE suggests testing 8-GPU N4 (pod-style) vs bigger-single-node layout to measure inter-GPU latency.
- Caching & batching: want prefix/KV caching to keep per-token cost down, but also strict latency guarantee. Need control over batching windows and max batching delay <= 5ms.
- Observability: token-level cost, per-request trace id in Redwood Console, per-model latency histograms, rollout canary metrics. Must produce trace samples for failed p95 events.
- SLA negotiation notes: customer requests 99.95% uptime + latency SLO crediting for p95 breaches. Propose 99.9% uptime for first year with latency SLO credits, then 99.95% after 6-month usage baseline. Finance asks for ARR banding to reach enterprise pricing.
- Security: strict VPC + customer-managed KMS, audit logging forwarded to their SIEM, data residency in us-east only for now. Legal flagged retention controls (90-day default, can request extension).
